_comment: Blocks whose word is never drawn onto a found page or into a found notebook. The word still exists and
is writable by anyone who learns it another way; for a thing that must have no word at all, use
`does_not_have_a_word`. Every registry a word can name may carry this tag, under its own tags/ folder.
Scrivener's rarity column writes it as `no loot`.
Plasma is learned only from the chest beside the fusion compounder (design 7, the summit).
**What the mod's progression is built of** (Jonah, 2026-10-21): one lucky page must not hand a writer an Age
whose trees, structures or formations are made of it. The desk and its archive and furnishings, the study's
implements, the stations, the linking portal and its receptacle, and the three inks, whose sea would be the
economy for nothing. Holding one and naming it at the analysis machine is still a way to learn it. The
acquaintance devices and the fusion compounder are wordless altogether (`does_not_have_a_word`).
